author: Animan
description:
These are 10 anime characters that are IMPOSSIBLE to kill: the most unkillable, immortal and overpowered anime characters ever written. From instant death powers and endless resurrection to reality resets and rewriting the story itself, here is how each one cheats death.

Yogiri Takatou kills anything just by deciding it's dead. Kyubey replaces his own body. Reinhard van Astrea resurrects again and again. And it only gets more broken from there, all the way up to beings who treat death as a story they're watching.

Which of these characters do you think is the hardest to kill? Tell me your pick in the comments.
